missing_components.description: Missing workflows to handle cancellation of rental contracts.
Relationship from Rental Contract to payment information is missing.

risks.description: No validation for the 'agree_to_terms' variable which could lead to contractual issues.
Missing explicit process for syncing data from External Beach Availability Service to local records.

recommendations.action: Add workflow to address rental contract cancellations and their details.
Establish and document relationships with payment-related data entities.
Implement a check to ensure 'agree_to_terms' is true before contract processing.
Outline data syncing processes and error handling for interactions with the External Beach Availability Service.
